newsitem.title: USA: Pepperidge Farm to recall two products.
newsitem.headline: Pepperidge Farm to recall two products.

text.p: Pepperidge Farm Inc. said Friday it was recalling limited lots of its fat-free pretzel mix and its seasoned snack mix because the products may contain peanuts not listed on the labels.

The recall affects the 9.25-ounce and 1.5-ounce size of the pretzel mix, and 9.25-ounce packages of the seasoned snack mix. The products could cause an allergic reaction among people who are sensitive to peanuts.
Norwalk, Conn.-based Pepperidge Farm is a unit of Campbell Soup Co.
Campbell's stock fell 25 cents to $83 on the New York Stock Exchange in early afternoon trading.
